Be kind to other growers, and remember that everyone here started out knowing nothing about soil or seed. Keep each topic to one question so that others with the same trouble can find the answer later on. Search before you post: most questions about slugs, blight and carrot fly have been answered many times already. Photos help a great deal with pests and diseases, so add one if you can, taken in daylight and close up. Do not sell or advertise in the forum; there is a separate board for swaps and for spare seedlings. Moderators may move a topic to a better board, and will close a thread that turns into an argument. Posts in the first week are checked by hand before they show, so a new member's post can take a day. Report a post with the flag under it rather than replying, and a moderator will look at it within the day.
